 166: Sextus Propertius (ca. 5o-ca. 16 B.c.), Roman poet. The poem is loosely

arts of peace, ruler of storms, and a guardian of cities; usually understood as
a virgin goddess.
 166.7: in Greek mythology the Centaurs are usually depicted as having the
upper part of a human body and the four-legged body of a horse.
